facts.business: Sreeleathers Limited operates a chain of 31 retail stores across 8 states in India, selling footwear and leather accessories sourced locally from Kolkata, Agra, Mumbai, and Delhi, following a 'World Class, Right Price' value proposition with no seasonal sales.
key_risks: Interest Rate risk: fall in interest rates increases gratuity liability
Liquidity Risk: inability to meet short-term gratuity payouts
Salary Escalation Risk: deviation in future salary increases affects plan liability
Demographic Risk: actual mortality/attrition experience worse than assumptions
Regulatory Risk: changes in Payment of Gratuity Act requiring higher payouts
